items.title: The Girl by the Window

items.titleIt: La Ragazza alla Finestra
items.excerpt: The Girl by the Window. Edvard Munch (Norwegian, 1863–1944). 1893. Oil on canvas. Edvard Munch’s life and art have come to epitomize modern notions of anxiety. Created the same year as his renowned The Scream , this painting depicts a young girl in her nightgown gazing out at the city from her darkened room.

items.title: A Woman's Last Word
items.summary: La poesia 'A Woman’s Last Word' esplora il tema del silenzio e della comunicazione, usando metafore come le parole che possono essere sia potenti che ingannevoli. Il testo invita a trovare un equilibrio tra la capacità di esprimersi e l'importanza dell'armonia.
items.titleIt: Una Parola di Ultima Parola
items.excerpt:
Let's contend no more, Love,
Strive nor weep:
All be as before, Love,
--Only sleep!
What so wild as words are?
I and thou
In debate, as birds are,
Hawk on bough!
See the creature stalking
While we speak!
